broker.name: Eightcap
broker.tagline: Its site names 6 regulators, including ASIC, FCA, and CySEC. Rules depend on where you live. Advertised leverage: Up to 1:500.
broker.about: The Eightcap pages checked on 11 October 2026 do not state a founding year or one headquarters. Account names on its site include Standard and Raw. Platforms named there include MetaTrader 4, MetaTrader 5, TradingView, and TradeLocker. The site names these regulators: ASIC, FCA, CySEC, SCB, FSA (Seychelles), and FSC (Mauritius). The company on an account depends on where the client lives. A minimum deposit figure on the site is 100 USD. The highest leverage figure taken from those pages is Up to 1:500. Leverage increases losses as well as gains.
broker.regulators_note: The company behind an account depends on where you live. ASIC: Eightcap Pty Ltd, AFSL 391441. FCA: Eightcap Group Ltd, 921296. CySEC: Eightcap EU Ltd, 246/14. SCB: Eightcap Global Limited, SIA-F220. FSA (Seychelles): Eightcap International Ltd, SD100. FSC (Mauritius): Eightcap International Trading, GB25204603.

plans.name: Standard
plans.billing_note: Commission-free except shares include commission. Spreads as low as 1.0 pips. Trade size 0.01 to 100 lots. Margin call 80%. Stop-out 50%. Base currencies AUD, CAD, EUR, GBP, NZD, SGD, USD.

plans.name: Raw
plans.billing_note: Spreads from 0.0 pips. Account page: $3.50 commission per lot per side, and in the comparison table $3.50 AUD, USD, NZD, SGD, CAD; GBP 2.25; EUR 2.75 each side per standard lot. EURUSD spec page separately lists Raw commission as $7 USD, $7 AUD, $7 CAD, $7 NZD, 5.5 EUR, 4.5 GBP without saying per side.

broker.costs_note: Spreads and commissions move with the market, and they are not the same at every company in the group.

leverage.note: Labelled for Eightcap Global Limited (SYC regulated) on the EURUSD specification page. The FAQ says leverage depends on the entity and on retail or professional classification, and does not publish one group-wide cap.
Same SYC-entity label on the EURGBP specification page fetched on 2026-10-11. That fetch did not show separate ASIC, FCA or CySEC caps.

broker.leverage_note: Leverage increases losses as well as gains, and you can lose more than you deposit. The highest figure on this card is the highest number this broker advertises. It is not the cap on every account. The cap depends on the company, the product and where you live.

other_fees.label: Minimum deposit
other_fees.note: The English FAQ states: the minimum deposit is $100 (or equivalent in your account currency). The account-options page also shows $100 minimum deposit for Standard and Raw. The page uses a dollar sign and does not spell the word USD. Registration can be completed without a deposit; a minimum deposit is required before trading.

other_fees.label: Deposits and withdrawals
other_fees.note: FAQ: Eightcap does not charge any internal fees for deposits or withdrawals. The payment provider may charge a transaction or conversion fee.

other_fees.label: Share CFDs and swaps
other_fees.value: commissions on share CFDs; overnight and triple swaps
other_fees.note: FAQ says commissions are charged for share CFDs, and overnight and triple swaps apply, with swap rates tripled on a Wednesday. No interest is paid on funds held in trading accounts. Stop-out at 50% of required margin.
